 ○ F1  Info     Probe doesn't see subscription state  D6 D16

○ F1 Info · Probe doesn't see subscription state                                        D6 · D16
  What happened   customer.subscription.updated was delivered in Shuffled and Burst (D6 and
                  D16), and no probe reads subscription state.
  Why it matters  Out-of-order delivery usually breaks status fields, not counts.
                  Stripe docs › Webhooks › Event ordering
  Fix             Add a subscription entry to the probe in webhooktrap.yml. The next run then
                  checks both.
                  Snippet (webhooktrap.yml):
                    probe:
                      # keep your existing entries, then add:
                      - as: subscriptions.status
                        cmd: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -Atc "select status from subscriptions where stripe_id = '{{subscription.id}}'"
